tokens.npc_dota_hero_silencer_bio:
Part of the seventh and final generation of a carefully designed pedigree, Nortrom was bred by the ancient order of the Aeol Drias to be the greatest magic user the world had ever seen. He was the prophesied one, the culmination of two-hundred years of careful pairings, a war-mage who would bring glory to the order, and destruction to their sworn enemies, The Knights of the Fold.

Raised with other young mages in a hidden cantonment among the hills of the Hazhadal barrens, the order's preceptors waited for Nortrom's abilities to manifest. While the other students honed their talents with fire, or ice, or incantatory spells, Nortrom sat silent and talentless, unable to cast so much as a hex. As the day of final testing approached, he still hadn't found his magic. In disgust, the preceptors berated him, while the children laughed. "You are no mage," the head of the order declared. Still, Nortrom did not slink away. He entered the day of testing and faced down the young mages who had mocked him. And then his preceptors learned a valuable lesson: a lack of magic can be the greatest magic of all. Nortrom silenced the young mages one by one and defeated them in single combat, until he alone stood as champion of the Aeol Drias, in fulfillment of the prophecy.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_silencer_hype: Silencer changes the dynamic of every battle when he shuts down the enemy's ability to cast their spells. As he cuts his foes to ribbons with his glaive, he steals their intelligence to add to his own, ensuring his foes are always at a disadvantage.

fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** When unit-targeted, applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|silencer_last_word}} on the affected enemy unit.
** {{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-8-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-8-2.png|84px]]
*** {{cf|talnotes}} The upgrade changes the ability targeting functionality from unit-targeted to {{ValueColor||area-targeted|20tal}}.
**** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Last Word cast range}}+{{#var:Last Word type2 value1}}}}|20tal}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
**** Affects the following units:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.

* All components do not proc on abilities that does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|silencer_last_word}}
*** Applies a {{#var:Last Word value3}}-second offensive {{M|shared vision}} debuff on the affected enemy unit.
*** This is the first debuff component.
** The {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|silencer_last_word_disarm}} debuff applies different ability effects in the following sequence according to the proc conditions:
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
**** When proc upon the {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|silencer_last_word}} debuff-affected enemy unit's ability {{M|cast point}}:
****# {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}
****#* Checks Silencer's {{M|intelligence}} upon the component proc, set, and applies the total [[magical]] [[spell damage]] value.
****#** {{cf|expr}}
****#*** {{Code|[[Spell Damage|SpellDmg]] {{=}} {{#var:Last Word value1}} + (ΣSilencer[[Intelligence|Int]] - ΣEnemyInt) × {{#var:Last Word value2}}}}
****#*** {{Code|EnemyInt {{=}} 0}} If the affected unit has no {{M|attributes}}.
****#* Does not apply the next ability effects in sequence below upon the debuff-affected enemy unit's {{M|death}}.
****#* The spell damage component is applied regardless of all active {{M|damage negation}} sources.
****# Applies the {{M|silence}} duration.
****# {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{Symbol|bonus cd}}
****#* The debuff-affected enemy's ability is now cast.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
**** When proc upon the {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|silencer_last_word}} debuff expiring on the debuff-affected enemy unit:
****# The total {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
****# Applies the {{M|silence}} duration.

* The following sources has unique mechanic interactions with the ability, and follows ability component [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] when possible:
** {{Symbol|Channeling|t}}
*** Procs at the end of all [[channeling]] sources.
*** When the following sources are canceled prematurely:
**** {{A|Puck|Phase Shift}}
**** {{A|Riki|Tricks of the Trade}}

Applies Arcane Curse to heroes for Global Silence duration; multiple Scepter Global Silence curses do not stack. Linked Curse rank, immunity handling and ticking prevent assigning a fixed total from this owner ability alone.

sourceRecord: Global Silence shuts off every enemy spell — a hard counter to combo teams.
BKB and Manta dispel let key enemies ignore Global Silence and his Curse.
Linken's Sphere blocks Silencer's key single-target spell.
Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Silencer's magic damage and disables.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Silencer's targeted disable.
Pipe of Insight shields your team from Silencer's AoE magic damage.
To recast your ultimate twice in a fight.
Armor manipulation to amplify a target.
An ability upgrade for extra utility.
A popular core pickup on this hero.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_silencer
data.bio_loc:
Part of the seventh and final generation of a carefully designed pedigree, Nortrom was bred by the ancient order of the Aeol Drias to be the greatest magic user the world had ever seen. He was the prophesied one, the culmination of two-hundred years of careful pairings, a war-mage who would bring glory to the order, and destruction to their sworn enemies, The Knights of the Fold.

Raised with other young mages in a hidden cantonment among the hills of the Hazhadal barrens, the order's preceptors waited for Nortrom's abilities to manifest. While the other students honed their talents with fire, or ice, or incantatory spells, Nortrom sat silent and talentless, unable to cast so much as a hex. As the day of final testing approached, he still hadn't found his magic. In disgust, the preceptors berated him, while the children laughed. "You are no mage," the head of the order declared. Still, Nortrom did not slink away. He entered the day of testing and faced down the young mages who had mocked him. And then his preceptors learned a valuable lesson: a lack of magic can be the greatest magic of all. Nortrom silenced the young mages one by one and defeated them in single combat, until he alone stood as champion of the Aeol Drias, in fulfillment of the prophecy.
data.hype_loc: Silencer changes the dynamic of every battle when he shuts down the enemy's ability to cast their spells. As he cuts his foes to ribbons with his glaive, he steals their intelligence to add to his own, ensuring his foes are always at a disadvantage.
data.npe_desc_loc: Can silence all enemies on the map

abilities.name: silencer_curse_of_the_silent
abilities.desc_loc:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
abilities.lore_loc: Nortrom's lack of incantations is less of a problem for him than it is for his adversaries.

abilities.name: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
abilities.desc_loc: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
abilities.lore_loc: Although lacking in traditional incantations, Nortrom's pedigree of the Aeol Drias gives him uncanny wisdom, which he applies to physical combat.
abilities.shard_loc: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.
facets_loc: Increases the max level of Glaives of Wisdom. Level %max_level_tooltip% Glaives of Wisdom bounce %bounce_count_tooltip% time to a random target within %bounce_range_tooltip% range. The bounce costs mana upon hit and prioritizes heroes.

abilities.name: silencer_last_word
abilities.desc_loc: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
abilities.lore_loc: Nortrom ensures that spells uttered by his opponents will be their last.
notes_loc: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.

abilities.name: silencer_brain_drain
abilities.desc_loc:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases the Intelligence stolen per kill.

abilities.name: silencer_global_silence
abilities.desc_loc: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
abilities.lore_loc: With a shock to the ground, all magic and sound pauses, and Nortrom fulfills his prophecy.
notes_loc: This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.
abilities.scepter_loc: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.
facets_loc: The first time Global Silence ends on a unit it is applied again.
